title: Disqualifications.
bodyText: No person shall be an examiner who is a director of or owner of any interest, or shares of stock, in any company that may be examined pursuant to this chapter.
bodyHtml: §412:2-103  Disqualifications.  No person shall be an examiner who is a director of or owner of any interest, or shares of stock, in any company that may be examined pursuant to this chapter. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1]
